WITH account_order_counts AS (
    SELECT o.account_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM `order` AS o
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = o.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3
), overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_order_count
    FROM account_order_counts
), differences AS (
    SELECT account_id, region, order_count,
           order_count - avg_order_count AS difference_from_overall
    FROM account_order_counts
    CROSS JOIN overall_average
), regional_averages AS (
    SELECT region, AVG(difference_from_overall) AS avg_difference
    FROM differences
    GROUP BY region
)
SELECT d.account_id, d.region, d.order_count,
       d.difference_from_overall,
       d.difference_from_overall - r.avg_difference AS excess_over_region_average
FROM differences AS d
JOIN regional_averages AS r ON r.region = d.region
WHERE d.difference_from_overall > r.avg_difference
ORDER BY excess_over_region_average DESC
LIMIT 10
